sections.description:
THE NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE INDUSTRIAL, RELATIONS RULES, 1974
THE NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE INDUSTRIAL, RELATIONS RULES, 1974
[No. SOL‑V‑195/74,
dated 11th July, 1974. Rules framed by the Government of North‑West
Frontier Province, in consultation with the Federal Government, in exercise of the
powers conferred by sub‑section (2) of section 66 of the Industrial
Relations Ordinance, 1969 (Ord. XXIII of 1969).] [N. W. F. P. Govt. Gazette
Extr. Aug. 5, 1974, p. 138.]
CHAPTER‑I
GENERAL
1. Short title anus commencement.‑(1) These rules may be called
the North‑West Frontier Province Industrial Relations Rules,1974.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.‑(1) In these rules, unless the context
otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meaning hereby res pectively
assigned to them, that is to say :‑
(a) "Balloting Officer"
means an officer appointed as Balloting Officer under rule 25 ;
(b) "Director" means
the Director of Labour, North‑West Frontier Province ;
(c) 'Federation" means a
federation of, trade unions which a Registrar appointed by Government is
empowered to register ;
(d) "Form" means a
forth appended to these rules ;
(e) "Government" means
the Government of the North-West Frontier Province ;
(f) 'Ordinance" means the
Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969 (Ord. XXIII of 1969) ;
(g) "Polling Officer"
means an officer appointed as Polling Officer under rule 25 ;
(h) "Secret ballot" or
"ballot" means secret ballot held under section 22 ;
(i) "Section" means a
section of the Ordinance ;
(j) "Trade Union" or
"Union" means a trade union or union registered Linden section 13:
(k) "Voter" means a
person whose name is included in the list verified by the Registrar under sub‑section
(5) of section 22.
(20 All other words and
expressions used but not defined in there rules shall have the same meanings as
are assigned to them in tile Ordinance,
3. Application for registration.‑(1) Every application for
registration of a trade union made under section 5 shall be in Form A'.
(2) Every application for
registration of a federation of trade unions wade under section 20 shall be in
Form 'B'.
4. Maintenance of register of in embers, account books, minutes books,
etc.=(1) The application for the membership of trade union shall be in Form
'C'.
(2), Every registered trade union
shall maintain of members in Form' D' showing particulars of subscriptions paid
by member.
(3) Every registered Federation
shall maintain a register in Form E' showing all moneys received by it.
(4) Every registered trade union
or registered federation shall maintain an account book in Form V showing its
receipts and expenditure. The account book shall be a bound register and all
pages shall be numbered serially.
(5) Every registered trade union
or registered federation shill issue printed receipts for all moneys received
and shall maintain granted receipt hooks every page of which shall be numbered
serially, and an account of all' such receipt books shall be maintained.
(ii) All expenses to be incurred
by a trade union or federation of trade unions shall be supported by vouchers
in original.
(7) Every registered trade union
or registered federation shall maintain a minutes book. The minutes book shall
be a bound register, its all pages shall be numbered serially, and it shall contain
the following information.
(a) date, place and time at which
the meetings of the general body or the executive committee of the trade union
or federation of trade unions are held ;
(b) details of ail points
discussed and all resolutions passed:
(c) in the case of meetings of
the general body, the approximate number of workers who attended the meetings
of the executive committee, the names, and signatures of the officers of the
executive who attended the meeting.
(8) The minutes of a meeting recorded
in minutes book shall be confirmed in the subsequent meeting after reading out
the minutes loudly arid taking consent of all members present.

with fine which may extend to one hundred rupees.
